# Inputs and outputs (not included): ward stays and vital signs

Not distributable (personal health information).

## Raw exports read by `p1_whole_admtc_vit_fromCIS.Rmd`

Monthly exports from the Kyoto University Hospital clinical data warehouse (CSV, bzip2), exported on
2023-08-14 and kept in `../../dat/p1_pts_parse/` (the folder `dat/p1_pts_parse/` next to this project's
root). The Rmd lists the `admtc*` (ward stays, 46 columns) and `vit*` (vital signs, 52 columns) files in
sorted order and reads files 49–86 of each, which are the 38 months from January 2020 to February 2023.
